result.summary: The food delivery home screen renders cleanly overall. One notable issue is a duplicated restaurant entry in the 'Fastest near you' carousel; other observations are minor.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' carousel shows two identical 'Green Bowl Poké' entries with the same image, delivery fee (€0.90) and time (15–25 min), which appears to be a duplicate listing rather than distinct restaurants.
issues.suggestion: Deduplicate restaurant results in the carousel, or verify data source so distinct restaurants are shown.

issues.description: The heart/favorite icons on the 'Popular right now' cards have inconsistent styling — one has a light/white background while the other has a dark background, creating visual inconsistency.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon background treatment across all cards for a consistent look.
